history.summary: plan.md now carries two phases — PA gates Jenkinsfile.iac-image on the image's input set as verified from the Dockerfile this pass (the provider is off the list: terraform.rc resolves through the tfmirror.home network mirror, no filesystem-mirror bake), and PB moves the IaCAgent tree to support/iac-agent/ with its history intact and repoints iac_agent_local_checkout, leaving the host layout, both --limit exclusions and the sibling-checkout fallback alone. verification.json holds 16 outcome-level criteria covering R1-R7 and N1/N4/N5 with file:line evidence; no attachments were needed. The seeded requirements/rulings text is unchanged except that its three `###` sub-headings were demoted to `####` — run_loop.py reserves `###` for phase headings and refused to parse the plan otherwise; `--dry-run` now resolves both targets (root, ansible).

Three blocking findings: R4's README fix is forbidden by V06's byte-identical clause and owned by no phase (the doc charter's five surfaces do not reach support/iac-agent/README.md); V09 carries a doc-truth universal that collides with the R6/N5 ruling keeping /work/IaCAgent alive; and the hasChanges contract the plan records as unverified is readable in JenkinsPipelineUtils and uses full-match `==~`, which the plan never states.

All three blocking findings are resolved per the rulings. R4's README/comment drift now has an owner: new phase PC edits the moved tree's prose after PB lands it as a pure rename, and V06's byte-identity is scoped to the move rather than to slice end. V09 lost its doc-truth universal and is bounded to files inside support/iac-agent/; V15 was reconciled with the R4 ruling's named send_message.py docstring fix; PA now carries the verified hasChanges full-match contract (Groovy ==~, trailing /.* on directory prefixes) plus a new V17 that makes the pattern shape statically checkable. Three phases, dry-run parses clean.
